d: A three-headed monstrous creature with dark grey skin, wearing massive, heavy black and charcoal-grey plated armor featuring glowing purple runes. The three heads are beast-like with sharp teeth, glowing purple eyes, and a singular central head wearing a horned helmet. The build is immensely muscular and bulky, covered in thick pauldrons and leg guards, with a tattered purple cloth loincloth hanging between the legs. BODY COLOR: Dark grey LEGS: Plantigrade, encased in heavy armored boots with thick, blunt toes.
